DeployBot: automated publish repo=redwood/api image=api:20260321-b1 -> PROVENANCE_FAIL: missing cosign attestation for linux/arm64; publish partial and quarantined.
mira: noticed on dashboard. Canary currently only on amd64. Is arm64 pull failing or only guard?
kevin: only guard. manifest list exists but attestation blob absent for arm64. CI had a transient permission error during sign.
ops-bot: KMS logs show Deny for ci-runner (sts-assumed) at 02:10Z due to conditional tag mismatch.
release-lead: change window 20m. Options: 1) republish with attestation (estimate 12m) 2) pin canary to previous attested digest and delay arm64 3) rollback. Preference: republish if quick.
mira: assigning kevin to republish, ops to patch KMS condition temporarily. kevin -> update here with status.
kevin: starting republish from artifact cache, will cosign using key version v4 on control node to avoid runner policy.
ops-bot: applied temporary IAM passthrough for ci-runner; scheduled revert in 15m.
kevin: cosign sign now OK. verify output: "Verification -- OK". pushed updated manifest list with attestation for arm64.
DeployBot: publish guard re-check passed; full publish complete. canary promotion unlocked.
release-lead: promoted canary to arm64 pools; monitoring 5m. updating release notes to mention provenance re-publish and KMS policy follow-up.
mira: create infra ticket to tighten CI principal conditions and add pre-sign check in pipeline. Closing thread if no anomalies.
